Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic immunopeptidomics study focusing on MHC-II (HLA-DR) bound peptides. Two DDA workflows were used. Search parameters explicitly specified 'no enzyme' or 'non-specific cleavage' due to the nature of immunopeptidomics. Variable modifications included methionine oxidation and pyroglutamic acid.

scope: Peptide-HLA-DR complexes were purified from pulsed and non-pulsed MoDC samples

HLA-DR-peptide complexes in the supernatant were collected from the soluble fraction and incubated in rotation at 4°C for 18 hours with 0.01 ml of CNBr-activated sepharose beads (GE Healthcare Life Sciences) coupled to the monoclonal anti-HLA-DR antibody (clone L243, Bio X Cell).
After incubation, HLA-DR-peptide complexes were purified by immunoprecipitation using Bio-Spin Chromatography Columns (Bio-Rad).
